```{r, setup, include=FALSE }

library(knitr)
library(here)

# site_root <- file.path(here(), "reports/HW-Chars.Recognition.Site")
# knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

# Get the directory where this .Rmd file is located
doc_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))

# Construct the standard R Markdown figure directory path inside the document folder
doc_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input()))
fig_dir  <- file.path(doc_dir, paste0(doc_name, "_files"), "figure-latex", "/")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = fig_dir)

# Save the default output hook
default_output_hook <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("output")

# Override the output hook to check for a custom 'output.size' chunk option
knitr::knit_hooks$set(output = function(x, options) {
  # First, let knitr format the output normally (adds ``` fences)
  out <- default_output_hook(x, options)
  
  # If output.size is specified on the chunk, wrap the output block in LaTeX size commands
  if (!is.null(options$output.size)) {
    paste0("\n\\", options$output.size, "\n", out, "\n\\normalsize\n")
  } else {
    out
  }
})
